audit.why: Both layers give Jayce levels 1 and 6 and hand Rumble 3-5 and everything from first item on; this matches the mirror audit (rumble__jayce.json) and Rumble's 48.56% into Jayce. No side or rating changed.
Spikes at 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), 6 (The Equalizer, 130s at rank 1), first item and 2+ items are correctly placed and agree with the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells you to 'Thundering-Blow him out of his own channel' and to 'bait the Scrap Shield with a Cannon Q'. Flamespitter is not a channel, and Scrap Shield is a 6-second cooldown you cannot bait away.
audit.why: Riot's text: Flamespitter 'creates a cone of flame' for its duration — a knockback does not interrupt it, it relocates Rumble so the burn lands on ground you are not standing on. That is exactly what the mirror audit corrected from Rumble's side. Scrap Shield is 6s flat at every rank, so it is back for the next trade; the orb has to be the accelerated one, not chip.
audit.corrected: Knockback repositions, it does not interrupt; and 6s means the shield is not a resource you can drain.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Scrap Shield 6s, Flamespitter 10/9/8/7/6s, The Equalizer 130/105/80s. Those three numbers are what turn 'trade on his cooldown' into an actual instruction.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours: he still cannot answer the gate-Q from range, so keep shoving his step-ups and bank a health lead for plates before he hits 6. Then respect the swing — The Equalizer is a real level-6 ultimate and yours is not, since Jayce's R is just the Hextech Capacitor stance-swap you have had since level 1. Once his ult is up, never all-in over open ground he can carpet; bait the Scrap Shield with a Cannon Q, and when he commits to Flamespitter with the shield down, swap to Hammer and Thundering-Blow him out of his own channel — the max-HP magic damage on the knockback stings and the swap's burst of move speed lets you disengage clean before the burn catches you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours: he still cannot answer the gate-Q from range, so keep shoving his step-ups and bank a health lead for plates before he hits 6. Then respect the swing — The Equalizer is a real level-6 ultimate and yours is not, since Jayce's R is just the Hextech Capacitor stance-swap you have had since level 1. Once his ult is up, never all-in over open ground he can carpet. Scrap Shield is 6 seconds flat, so stop trying to bait it off and pick your window on Flamespitter instead: when the flames are already out, swap to Hammer and Thundering-Blow him — that does not interrupt the burn, it moves him so the cone finishes on ground you are not standing on, and the swap's burst of move speed carries you clear.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
